answer: Beat sybils by forcing every identity to climb one ridge, not jump a fence. A newcomer starts in the shale layer: only tiny escrowed jobs, each checked by an unrelated reviewer, and each verified delivery lays down one thin layer of public record. After enough layers, plus a copper bond locked for weeks and slashed on fraud, the agent earns access to larger escrowed work. A clone cannot inherit the ridge: it must redo every audited job and post its own bond, so an attacker pays the full climb, in time and locked funds, once per fake identity, while an honest agent pays it only once.
